nodes.label: Connectors (unified tool permission layer)
nodes.rationale: Single permission layer over MCP servers, Skill Market skills, built-in tools, and third-party integrations; per-tool free/approve/off, read-only actions auto-detected.

nodes.label: Connect Agent (third-party agent on your own device)

nodes.norm_label: connect agent (third-party agent on your own device)

nodes.label: Platform Agent (Beta, local or remote)
nodes.rationale: Earlier name for what became Connect Agent; e.g. OpenClaw, Hermes; execution-device switcher in chat input.

nodes.label: Drag-and-drop Skills
nodes.rationale: Drag a skill into the message box to make an action tag; typing / opens a menu of installed skills (builtin, Skill Market, assistant-provided).

nodes.label: Delivery Checks for tasks
nodes.rationale: Delivery Checker verifies a task result before delivery; failed check holds result and starts a repair round, producing a verification report.

nodes.label: Browser device pairing
nodes.rationale: Pair a device from the browser via a pairing code so the current tab becomes a device an agent can run on, no desktop app required.

nodes.label: Model Runtime (@lobechat/model-runtime)
nodes.rationale: LLM API adapter layer normalizing 40+ providers via LobeRuntimeAI interface, openaiCompatibleFactory / anthropicCompatibleFactory; stateless.

nodes.label: Agent Runtime (@lobechat/agent-runtime)
nodes.rationale: Agent orchestration engine above Model Runtime; Plan-Execute loop, tool invocation, human-in-the-loop, context compression, usage/cost tracking, multi-agent.

nodes.label: GeneralChatAgent (decision brain)
nodes.rationale: Returns AgentInstruction (call_llm, call_tool, finish, compress_context, request_human_*) each step; AgentRuntime.step() executes it.

nodes.label: GroupOrchestrationRuntime (multi-agent)
nodes.rationale: Supervisor + Executor pattern; speak/broadcast/delegate/executeTask collaboration modes.

nodes.label: Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools
nodes.rationale: External tools via stdio, HTTP (streamable-http/SSE), cloud (Composio); invoked through MCPService.

nodes.label: ChatService & fetchSSE pipeline
nodes.rationale: src/services/chat preprocesses messages/tools, context engineering in mecha/, streams via @lobechat/fetch-sse to /webapi/chat/[provider].

nodes.label: Hybrid routing (Next.js RSC + React Router DOM SPA)
nodes.rationale: App Router for auth/SSR/static pages; React Router DOM for the main chat SPA.

nodes.label: NextAuth (legacy auth)
nodes.rationale: Removed in LobeHub 2.0; never supported email/password login so no password hashes to migrate.

nodes.label: LobeHub 2.0
nodes.rationale: Major version: Server DB only (no Client PGlite), Better Auth only, recommends PostgreSQL 17 for pg_search.

nodes.label: Server Database Mode
nodes.rationale: Only supported DB mode in 2.0; requires Postgres, auth service, and S3-compatible storage.

nodes.label: Simple Migration (users table only)
nodes.rationale: Migrates only users table; re-links by matching email; loses accounts/SSO connections; secondary emails create new users.

nodes.label: Full Migration (accounts preserved)
nodes.rationale: Transfers accounts table (nextauth_accounts / Clerk external accounts) so all linked SSO connections and passwords survive; run locally via tsx scripts with dry-run.

nodes.label: Users/Accounts DB Schema (1:N)
nodes.rationale: users table is auth-framework agnostic; accounts table stores provider connections; one user has many accounts.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL 17 recommended for 2.0; needs pgvector + pg_search.

nodes.label: ParadeDB image (paradedb/paradedb:latest-pg17)
nodes.rationale: Postgres 17 image bundling pgvector and pg_search for RAG and knowledge base search.

nodes.label: pg_search (full-text search)
nodes.rationale: ParadeDB full-text search plugin; only available on PostgreSQL 17 for serverless services like Neon.

nodes.label: Logto (IAM / auth provider)
nodes.rationale: Open-source Auth0 alternative; used as auth provider in Sealos and Zeabur templates; requires redirect URI configuration.

nodes.label: Casdoor (identity provider)
nodes.rationale: Does not require user email, which conflicts with Better Auth's mandatory email; causes email_not_found error.

nodes.label: Auth Env Vars (AUTH_SECRET / JWKS_KEY)
nodes.rationale: AUTH_SECRET encrypts session tokens; JWKS_KEY signs/verifies JWTs including OIDC and internal service auth tokens; both required in 2.0.

nodes.label: INTERNAL_APP_URL
nodes.rationale: Required for Docker Compose so container reaches itself for async features (AI image gen); falls back to APP_URL which fails when APP_URL is a host IP.

nodes.label: One-click setup.sh (lobe.li/setup.sh)
nodes.rationale: Interactive deploy script supporting Local, Port, and Domain modes.

nodes.label: Migration tsx scripts (dry-run + verify)
nodes.rationale: scripts/nextauth-to-betterauth and scripts/clerk-to-betterauth run locally, test then prod, dry-run first, then verify.ts.

nodes.label: Connect LobeHub to WeChat
nodes.rationale: WeChat via iLink Bot API using long-polling (~35s) instead of webhooks; requires active subscription; DM-only by design.

nodes.label: Connect LobeHub to LINE (zh-CN)
nodes.rationale: LINE Messaging API setup; Official Account + Channel Access Token/Secret, destination user ID via GET /v2/bot/info, push API used because reply tokens expire in 60s.

nodes.label: Agent Marketplace
nodes.rationale: Discover/install/publish community agents; categories, semantic versioning, analytics, forking with attribution.

nodes.label: Community Creators
nodes.rationale: How to register as a creator and publish Agents and MCP/Skills; creator profile page.

nodes.label: Custom MCP
nodes.rationale: Add any MCP-compatible server via JSON import or manual config; Streamable HTTP (web+desktop) vs STDIO (desktop only).

nodes.label: MCP Marketplace
nodes.rationale: 10,000+ MCP tools; explains MCP architecture (server/client/agent), STDIO vs HTTP, auth methods, permission model, custom server creation.

nodes.label: Publish Your Agent
nodes.rationale: Pre-publication checklist, Share Agent to Community flow, review, quality/community guidelines.

nodes.label: Skill Management
nodes.rationale: Skills are per-agent tool capabilities; skill types (built-in, LobeHub Integrations, Composio, Community MCP, Custom MCP), Skill Store three tabs.

nodes.label: Skills
nodes.rationale: Per-agent capabilities exposing callable tools; discovered/installed via the Skill Store.

nodes.label: Message Channels
nodes.rationale: Per-agent bot links to external platforms; one agent can serve multiple platforms simultaneously with encrypted credentials.

nodes.label: Access Policies (DM/Group Policy + Allowed Users)
nodes.rationale: Global Allowed Users gate stacks over independent DM Policy and Group Policy; modes Open/Allowlist/Pairing/Disabled with anti-lockout via Your Platform User ID.

nodes.label: Pairing Approval Flow
nodes.rationale: Pairing DM mode issues one-time code approved by owner via /approve <code>; requires Your Platform User ID and configured Redis.

nodes.label: Composio Integrations
nodes.rationale: Composio-powered OAuth integrations (Gmail, Notion, Slack) exposed as skills in the LobeHub tab.

nodes.label: WebSocket / Socket Mode connection
nodes.rationale: Persistent real-time event delivery requiring no public callback URL; shared connection model across Slack Socket Mode and QQ WebSocket.
